title: StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs

body: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.
summaryZh: StagQ是一种创新的多精度权重量化格式，旨在解决大模型在不同部署场景下对多种精度需求的问题。该方法通过2位仿射基底配合可配置的1位细化平面，实现了从单一数据流中解码多种精度，无需存储多份权重副本。实验表明，StagQ在Llama-3.1-8B等模型上显著提升了MMLU得分，并在A100 GPU上实现了比现有基准更快的矩阵向量乘法速度，为高效模型部署提供了新方案。

glossary.explanationZh: 通过降低模型权重数值精度来减少内存占用和计算开销的技术。
一种基于仿射变换的量化基底，用于将权重映射到特定数值范围。
在基础量化之上增加的额外位平面，用于逐步提升量化精度。
大模型推理中最核心的计算操作，其效率直接决定了推理速度。
